selection.summary: Issue #1971: `gh repo view .` failed because the "." argument was treated as an owner/name slug (ghrepo.FromFullName errored). Fix in pkg/cmd/repo/view/view.go: viewRun now treats RepoArg == "." the same as no argument, resolving the repository via opts.BaseRepo() (the current directory's repo), and the command help text documents that "." refers to the current directory's repository. Added a ". arg" test case in Test_ViewRun (pkg/cmd/repo/view/view_test.go) asserting the local repo's README is rendered.
